cross_check_vs_render_harness.verdict: AGREE — independent seg-bracket lands within 0.3 px of the harness band. No material disagreement.

confound_DECLARED: Subject-height fraction conflates CAMERA FRAMING with BODY SIZE. The werewolf frame and the arena frame photograph DIFFERENT bodies. A difference in h_frac therefore does NOT by itself establish that the two cameras differ, and equality would NOT by itself establish that they match. This cell measures screen register only; it does not adjudicate R-CPB-17b's 'zoom/angle looks the same'.
cannot_answer: What the arena subject IS. It reads as a large wheel/rim + radial-spoke mass with a cylindrical base, not an unambiguous humanoid; a second instance of the same asset sits top-right of frame. Identity is drax's seam.
Whether the tall narrow upper element (y246-340) is a weapon, a banner, or a leaning prop. Both brackets reported.
Whether the arena and werewolf cameras share operands. The clip contains a camera move (whole-frame diff on off-modal frames), so this frame's operands were not recoverable from the footage alone.
